text: Figure 8.4: Dependencies of an Implementation [TPS_BSWMDT_04042] Usage of DependencyOnArtifact⌈The class Depen- dencyOnArtifact can be aggregated by Implementation in several different roles. By this it can also be used to specify that a certain generator tool is required to integrate a module and/or that a certain artifact is generated. For libraries, like e.g. a math.lib, the desired version numbers can be specified via the attribute revisionLabel, therefore trying to ensure compatibility . Note that the specification of version numbers and other attributes is a meta-information about cer- tain artifacts which shall refer to a concrete catalog description. ⌋(RS_BSWMD_00034, RS_BSWMD_00037, RS_BSWMD_00044)This mechanism is described in more detail in the AUTOSAR Methodology , see [4].
